in_hebrew.name: פורטוניה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Fortunia is derived from the Latin word fortuna, meaning 'good fortune' or 'prosperity'. In Hebrew, it can be transliterated as פורטוניה (Purtonia), and its meaning can be translated as 'good fortune' or 'prosperity'.

in_greek.name: Τουκτίδια
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Fortunia has no exact equivalent in the Greek language. However, it can be translated as 'good luck' or 'prosperity' (ευτυχία, eutychia), and in Greek texts, it is sometimes transliterated as Τουκτίδια (Touktidia).

in_latin.name: Fortunia
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Fortunia is derived from the Latin word fortuna, meaning 'good fortune' or 'prosperity'. In Latin texts, it is often used to refer to a goddess of good fortune and prosperity.
